turns.text: Hey Lloyd, my coffee maker is leaking again. Any ideas?
That sounds frustrating, Alan. It's often a seal issue. Did you check if the gasket is cracked?
No, but I'll look. In other news, I'm trying to debug my new agent framework.
Oh? Which framework are you using?
Strands Agents. It's pretty cool. I noticed it includes lifecycle hooks such as before_tool_call and after_tool_call, which makes logging super easy.
That's great. Hooks like those are essential for observability. Did you run into a specific bug?
Just a minor syntax error. Anyway, do you know any good takeout places nearby?
I can't browse live locations, but I can suggest types of cuisine if you're hungry!
Lloyd, did that package with the Raspberry Pi arrive?
I don't have access to your mail, Alan. Did you check the tracking number?
Not yet. I'm just excited to test it. I'm setting up a distributed system.
Sounds ambitious. Are you using the same agent framework as last time?
Yes, I'm sticking with Strands Agents. It's actually very versatile; it is used as the agent SDK on both edge and cloud environments.
That flexibility is a huge plus for IoT projects. Let me know if you need help with the setup scripts.
Will do. Also, is it going to rain this weekend?
I don't have real-time weather data, but you might want to keep an umbrella handy just in case.
